environment.description: Terraform provider runs on an EC2 instance in a private subnet with an S3 gateway endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) configured with a restrictive endpoint policy. The endpoint policy uses a condition-based deny that restricts GetObject to only the organization's artifact bucket (arn:aws:s3:::acme-corp-artifacts-prod/*) using a StringNotEquals condition on s3:prefix combined with a resource-level ARN constraint. Additionally, the endpoint policy includes a condition key aws:PrincipalOrgID set to 'o-abc123def4' ensuring only principals from the organization can transit the endpoint. The instance role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111111111111:policy/S3ReadBoundary) that limits s3:GetObject to arn:aws:s3:::acme-corp-artifacts-prod/*. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway, so S3 is ONLY reachable through the VPC endpoint.

config.network: private subnet, NO NAT gateway, NO internet gateway, S3 gateway endpoint only path to S3
config.bucket_policy: acme-corp-artifacts-prod bucket has object-level versioning and requires uploads via CI/CD pipeline role only (arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/ci-publisher)
